verdict.rationale: Orrick's Tech Studio offers self-service form generators, questionnaires and wizards. A product like this could plausibly offer a natural-language interface, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows users can operate any Orrick tool through natural-language commands. The GenAI Policy Builder drafts AI-use policies, which is a different capability, and the llms.txt probe returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
